notes: Skipped-hour rule (lib/pipeline/resolveDates.ts zonedInstant, tests/unit/resolveDates.test.ts): a wall-clock time inside the spring-forward gap moves forward by the gap. 'this weekend' names the upgrade window, not a due date.

items.title: Pause the nightly backup job
items.quote: Please pause the nightly backup job by Saturday at 7pm.
items.note: Before the change: 7 PM EST = 00:00 UTC on Mar 14. The local due date stays Sat Mar 13.

items.title: Restart the backup job after the upgrade
items.quote: Can you restart the backup job Sunday at 2:30am once the upgrade finishes?
items.note: 2:30 AM does not exist on Mar 14 in New York; it becomes 3:30 AM EDT = 07:30 UTC (the same instant as reading it with the old EST offset). 06:30 UTC would mean the nonexistent 2:30 was read as EDT, an instant before the change; local due date stays Sun Mar 14 either way.

items.title: Post-upgrade report from Lena
items.quote: I'll send the post-upgrade report on Monday at 8am.
items.note: Written by Lena, not the user. After the change: 8 AM EDT = 12:00 UTC (13:00 would mean the EST offset was kept).
